[Field Service](rn_fieldservice.md "See what’s new in Field Service to help your team deliver on performance and customer service.")

Several products are newly available for Government Cloud Plus. Use AWS Direct Connect (DX) as a direct-connectivity solution to access your Hyperforce orgs. Salesforce Shield supports encrypting your entire org on Hyperforce with Database Encryption. Salesforce Out of Region Disaster Recovery is renamed to Salesforce Advanced Cross-Region Continuity.")

Use the new Omni Global Auto Number page to create unique numbering systems for specific business needs. The Flexcard, Omniscript, and Omnistudio PubSub Lightning components are now available directly in the Salesforce Lightning Component Library and can be added to your custom Lightning web component (LWC) projects. Boost the runtime performance of your components by using the Enhanced Runtime Performance setting.")

Bring together key capabilities like deal registration, incentives, training, and performance tracking so your team can scale indirect sales and improve partner relationships.
